_about: German occupation of Western Europe, 9 April 1940 – 8 May 1945 (see build-borders.py). `regions` give each country's occupation date, from OpenHistoricalMap boundaries (France's two zones from `occupationAnchors`: each place takes the date of the nearest such town); `anchors` give liberation dates. Each place takes the occupation date of its region and the liberation date of its nearest anchor; `liberated: null` means German-held to the end of the map. Anchors marked `pocket` are circles of `radiusKm` that override their surroundings. Annexed Alsace-Lorraine, Luxembourg and Eupen-Malmedy are handled as German Reich territory (reich-capture-anchors.json). `approx` and `confidence: search-quote` as in the other anchor files.

regions.name: Norway
regions.note: Invaded on 9 April 1940; the north held out until Norway surrendered on 10 June.

regions.name: Netherlands
regions.note: Date of the invasion; the conquest took several days.

regions.name: Belgium
regions.note: Date of the invasion; Belgium capitulated on 28 May.

regions.name: France
regions.note: OpenHistoricalMap has no demarcation line, so the 1940–42 zones are approximated from towns on each side: by the armistice of 22 June 1940 Germany occupied northern France and the Atlantic coast down to Spain; southern France, with the regime's seat at Vichy, stayed unoccupied until 11 November 1942 (USHMM).

anchors.name: Normandy beachhead (Bayeux)
anchors.note: Allied landing in Normandy on 6 June 1944 (D-Day); the radius is a rough size of the first beachhead.
